acceptance_scope: Independent Darwin ARM64 single-threaded M19c functionality; does not accept historical M19b or the overall M19 release.

architecture.stability: Arena end, origins, metadata bases and live object addresses never move; mprotect changes page-prefix access only.
architecture.generations: Shared exact layouts, shadow roots, young list, remembered owners and in-place promotion; Young LOS can die in independent Minor.
architecture.reclamation: Zero type after safe sweep; ordinary GC prunes at most 8 LOS mappings per call. Unreleased or failed-release mappings remain owned and charged.

budget.object_cap_algorithm: min(requested_limit,(physical_bytes-256MiB)/12,(finite_soft_limit-64KiB)/6), page-rounded; conservative 16MiB hardware-query fallback; fail if no viable budget.
budget.hard_cap: 3*round_page(object_capacity)+64KiB; explicit managed hard cap derives page-rounded object capacity. Both object occupancy and page-charge checks apply.
budget.reserved: Exact page-rounded virtual mapping lengths including LOS and capacity-sized side metadata.
budget.committed: Conservative writable managed-page charge: prefix high-water extents including side metadata, fixed-page allowance and full LOS mapping lengths; bounded by reservation. Not an exact OS physical-commit/RSS measurement.
budget.rss: Per-native-child wait4 peak RSS; separate from managed budget.
budget.growth: Unused Arena and Side Metadata suffixes PROT_NONE; page-rounded mprotect commits stable prefixes. Startup goal <=1MiB.
budget.shrink: Goal shrinks after GC; ordinary committed prefixes retain high water; LOS pages are released in bounded batches.

pressure.publication: Copied native eight-word snapshot; odd/even sequence. Single-threaded ordinary loads/stores; NOT a concurrent-reader atomic protocol.

performance_caveat: All samples retained, fixed-seed interleaving and matched image/input controls. Concurrent validation and host load are recorded. No universal speedup, HTTP p99, production pause SLA or controlled system-memory-exhaustion claim. Small-object allocation overhead and conservative Critical prediction remain visible.

race_history.name: go-full-race
race_history.reason: 30m package deadline reached in TestM17ePureMioFarRuntimeError, TestCodegenSelfAndBunkoSources and TestMioTypecheckerSelfAndBunkoSources under recorded CPU contention; no race warning reported. Not treated as PASS.

race_history.name: go-full-race-60m-retry
race_history.reason: Only Mio/selfhost/codegen exceeded 60m; all other packages passed including AOT and selfhost typecheck. No race warnings. Same tests/inputs under unchanged host load.

race_history.name: go-race-codegen-120m-retry
race_history.reason: Entire codegen package rerun exceeded 120m in TestCodegenSelfAndBunkoSources; stack remained in Go VM arithmetic execution. No WARNING: DATA RACE in log. Exec session no longer available after interruption; terminal log records package FAIL.

upstream_m19b.release_blocker: No valid full-repository Race PASS until one is actually obtained. Historical M19b NOT_ACCEPTED remains unchanged.

known_limits: Raw allocation-rate exhaustion prediction is deliberately conservative and can report Critical for sustained collectible churn; production policy calibration remains for M19f.
Committed is a managed-page-charge upper bound, not precise OS physical commitment.
No ordinary Arena page decommit on Goal shrink.
LOS exact-start lookup walks the mapping chain; no concurrent release worker.
The 22k-live-object growth fixture runs normal mode; GCStress coverage uses the smaller cross-generation, closure, nullable and Storage fixtures.
No fixed-point reuse of historical images: final-source native bootstrap is independently recorded.

not_run.name: multithread snapshot publication
not_run.reason: Runtime is single-threaded; future atomic protocol required.
